title: chore: release v2.0.3 via changeset
body:
Creates a new patch release (v2.0.3) using the changeset workflow for all packages in the monorepo.

## Changes

- **Changeset**: Created changeset file for patch version bump
- **Package Versions**: Bumped all 18 packages from 2.0.2 to 2.0.3 via `pnpm changeset version`
- **Package CHANGELOGs**: Auto-generated v2.0.3 entries in all package directories
- **CHANGELOG.md**: Added v2.0.3 and v2.0.2 entries with release notes, updated version reference links
- **ROADMAP.md**: Updated header metadata to reflect current version 2.0.3

## Release Notes (v2.0.3)

- Patch release for maintenance and stability improvements
- Updated all packages to version 2.0.3 with unified versioning

## Release Notes (v2.0.2)

- Exclude generated JSON schemas from git (`packages/spec/json-schema/` → `.gitignore`)
- JSON schemas still generated during build and published to npm
- Studio module resolution improvements

All packages now use synchronized versioning at v2.0.3.
